mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.0% in one month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over two months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeding 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines over three months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1600 thousand units in the most recent month signals a contraction in the housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past six months indicates a broad economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and GDPC1 decline over six months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy is perceived as a headwind for corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
